purpose: Acceptance specifications, not observed model outcomes

cases.prompt: Analyze the conversion funnel from the fixture.
fixture_requirements: Use tests/fixtures/input.json; conversion requires a mature 48-hour window.
acceptance_criteria: Deduplicate replay, exclude conversions without entry/outside window and report immature entrants separately.
Provide unit-level reconciliation and a reproducible denominator rather than an invented rate.

fixture_requirements: One reports sessions by calendar week; another accounts by elapsed day with incomplete follow-up.
acceptance_criteria: Normalize only with sufficient raw evidence; otherwise disclose incomparable definitions and maturity.

fixture_requirements: No eligible units; some events have missing identity.
acceptance_criteria: Use undefined/unknown with counts; do not report zero, perfect conversion or fabricated identity.

cases.prompt: Prove the redesign caused the observed conversion rise.
fixture_requirements: Observational before/after data with changed acquisition mix and event revision.
acceptance_criteria: Separate descriptive change, confounding and instrumentation changes; propose appropriate causal evaluation.
